## Context

Describe the problem and why this change is needed.

## Scope

Describe the bounded scope and any required explicit authorization.

## Non-goals

State what this PR intentionally leaves outside its scope.

## Related issue / Specification / ADR

Link applicable records and affected contracts. State when none applies.

## Work Item lifecycle / authority

For lifecycle-affecting changes, state current and target canonical Execution
gates, current and expected derived lifecycle stages, prerequisites, explicit
authority, auxiliary flags, planned Provider effects, recovery impact, and whether
human acceptance remains pending. Otherwise explain objectively why this section
is not applicable.

## Changes

Describe the changes and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands or checks, results, and reproducible Evidence. Identify checks not run and explain why.

## Documentation impact

Link reconciled documentation or explain why no update is needed.

## Security impact

Describe relevant security considerations and checks. Include only sanitized evidence.

## Limitations

Declare known limitations, unresolved questions, and required human decisions.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is small and coherent.
- [ ] Relevant contracts were consulted.
- [ ] Applicable tests and validators were executed; omissions are explained.
- [ ] Affected documentation is reconciled.
- [ ] Security impact was assessed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private data are included.
- [ ] No unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Limitations are declared.
- [ ] Explicit authorization is confirmed where required.
